title: Login fails with 500 error when email contains plus sign
description: Users with email addresses containing a '+' character (e.g., user+tag@example.com) receive a 500 Internal Server Error when attempting to log in. The error originates from the email validation regex in the auth module.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Navigate to /login
2. Enter email: test+tag@example.com
3. Enter any password
4. Click 'Sign In'
5. Observe 500 error page
error_logs:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/auth/validators.py", line 42, in validate_email
    match = EMAIL_REGEX.match(email)
TypeError: expected string or bytes-like object, got 'NoneType'

During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:
  File "/app/auth/views.py", line 87, in login_view
    validated = validate_email(request.POST['email'])
  ...
django.core.exceptions.ValidationError: Invalid email format
